properties.NAME: TULARE
properties.CHANGE: TULARE lost to creation of KINGS. Act passed 22 March 1893; referendum for or against creation of new county held 23 May 1893. See 1986_pt.shp and 1991_pt.shp for the location of small, non-mappable changes.
properties.CITATION: Calif. Stats. 1893, 30th sess., ch. 150/pp. 176-181; Kings County History, http://calflytech.com/kingshistory.html, 18 July 2002
